column1: # Upstream files of this release: the corresponding source the two engines were built from. tools/fetch.sh
# downloads each into downloads/fetch/<id>/<file> and refuses one whose SHA-256 differs from the pin here.
# engine: arm64, x86_64 or both. ship: "source" = a release asset.
# The hashes are the ones the engines' own build scripts pin (arm64/ext.conf, x86_64/sources.tsv), which took them
# from Homebrew's formulae; the Wine archive has no published hash (tools/verify.sh shows that the archive plus
# each engine's patches gives exactly the tree that engine was built from).

column6: none published; pinned by x86_64/sources.tsv; verify.sh rebuilds both engines' Wine trees from it
Homebrew formula gnutls 3.8.13_2 (patch block): upstream GnuTLS commit 29c2027c, applied by both builds
